entries.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor

sources: Cinemeta (v3-cinemeta.strem.io) for ids, titles and dates
notes: Stephen Sommers' 1999 trilogy (Tomb of the Dragon Emperor completes it). The Scorpion King (optional) is a prequel spin-off set thousands of years earlier, first in the story order; its direct-to-video sequels, the 2017 Dark Universe film and the 1932 Universal series are left out.
